exposure: elective caesarean section for breech presentation in first pregnancy
outcome: mode of delivery in second pregnancy
cohort: The study included 321 women who had an elective caesarean section for breech presentation during their first pregnancy.
finding: Approximately 18.7% of women with a prior elective caesarean section for breech presentation achieved vaginal delivery in their second pregnancy, while 81.3% underwent a repeat caesarean section.
mod_finding: 18.7% of women with a prior elective caesarean section for breech presentation achieved vaginal delivery in their second pregnancy, with the majority (81.3%) having a repeat caesarean section.
